name: Filmstrip
description: A Lightroom-style filmstrip for the Develop module: a resizable strip of thumbnails docked under the canvas (or vertically on either side, with an optional list view) showing the Library's current filtered and sorted order. Full culling parity — click/Ctrl/Shift selection, the Library's right-click menu including extension actions, and its rating, flag, label, rotate, rename and delete shortcuts, without leaving Develop. Toggle with F6.
author: Anthony Reimche <anthonyreimche@gmail.com>
